Discovered 1 GPU nodes with product: NVIDIA-H100-80GB-HBM3
--- error: the controller has no write access in namespace "wr-cleanup-ns", which already existed.
nvcrectl grants access only in namespaces it creates, so an existing namespace does not become a standing grant by accident. Either:
  - run in a namespace that does not exist yet: nvcrectl creates it and grants access there
  - pass --grant-run-access to create the RoleBinding below in "wr-cleanup-ns"
  - apply it yourself, then run again:

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: nvcre-manager-run
  namespace: wr-cleanup-ns
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: nvcre-run-role
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: nvcre-manager
  namespace: nvcre
